comments: Reviewed source composition, source-foot pivots and cell order. Supplemental poses are reviewed proposals, not added animation states.
Exact canvas, stamp and rule timings retained. Native cleanup and plate slicing bake once in the renderer.
Shared source scale preserves growth/fade; ground effects share the original stamp bottom, impact stays centred. Attack decoration is clipped to rule danger.
geometry: Rule hook Area=156×23; visual repetition is decorative and does not extend collision. Danger rectangle continues to show the exact safe boundary.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheets and cleanup notes, 2026-10-15
